title: Sample-Rate Converter
text: Multistage sample-rate conversion, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough; {Sample rate of input signal (Hz)} sets the sample rate of input signal, {Sample rate of output signal (Hz)} sets the sample rate of output signal, {Tolerance for output sample rate} sets the maximum tolerance for output sample rate, {Two-sided bandwidth of interest (Hz)} sets the two-sided bandwidth of interest, {Stopband attenuation (dB)} sets the minimum attenuation for aliased components, {Allow arbitrary frame length for fixed-size input signals}, {View Filter Response}, {View Info} displays information about and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Sample rate of input signal (Hz)
params.values: Sample rate of input signal in Hz 48e3 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Sample rate of output signal (Hz)
params.values: Sample rate of output signal in Hz 96e3 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Tolerance for output sample rate
params.values: Maximum tolerance for output sample rate 0 (default) | positive scalar in the range [ 0, 0.5 ]

params.name: Two-sided bandwidth of interest (Hz)
params.values: Two-sided bandwidth of interest in Hz 40e3 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Stopband attenuation (dB)
params.values: Minimum attenuation for aliased components in dB 80 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Allow arbitrary frame length for fixed-size input signals
params.values: Allow arbitrary frame length for fixed-size input signals off (default) | on

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
